subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should the authorization, proof-input, bounded recovery, routing, and final-mutation hardening land together at this exact head?
rationale: Source review and checks support correctness, but only maintainers can accept the operational blast radius and the policy choice to terminate missing-handoff recovery after one compensating requeue.

options.title: Review and land together
options.body: Accept the combined fail-closed rollout after confirming the one-retry policy and exact-head privileged-boundary invariants.

options.title: Split recovery policy
options.body: Merge the other hardening separately and move the bounded missing-handoff recovery behavior to a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Review and land together
recommendation.body: Accept the combined fail-closed rollout after confirming the one-retry policy and exact-head privileged-boundary invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main staged-proof merge and broad contribution history make this person the strongest available owner for the combined rollout decision.
